prompt:
A warm, real photograph — documentary, not a studio shot — of SENIOR NIGHT at an American
high school, taken on the gym floor right after the ceremony.

THREE 18-year-old senior athletes stand together in the foreground, mid-celebration:
laughing, one arm around a shoulder, genuinely happy — not posing for a catalogue. They wear
their school letterman jackets and warm-ups over their kit, in deep green and cream. They are
a mixed group: one Pacific Islander boy, one Black girl, one Latino boy.

EACH of the three holds up ONE rectangular plate toward the camera, chest height, portrait
orientation, roughly the size of a trading card (2.5 x 3.5 inches). Every plate is
COMPLETELY BLANK MATTE PURE BLACK — no artwork, no writing, no logo, no glare, no reflection,
no texture, a flat black rectangle. The thumb rests ON the front face near a bottom corner so
each plate reads as held, and the plates are turned squarely to the lens so all four corners
of each are visible and none is cut off by the frame edge or by another person.

BEHIND them, on the low stage at the end of the gym, stand THREE large framed posters on
wooden easels, evenly spaced, angled slightly toward the camera. Each poster is also
COMPLETELY BLANK MATTE PURE BLACK inside its frame — no artwork, no writing, flat black, no
glass, no glare, no reflection. They are portrait, about 18 x 24 inches, and all four corners
of each are fully visible. They are slightly out of focus behind the people, but not blurred
away.

The gym is dark for the ceremony: warm ivory-white spotlights from above, fine champagne-gold
confetti still drifting and settling on the floor, a deep out-of-focus crowd in the stands
glittering with phone lights. Warm, emotional, premium — the last home game.

Hard requirements:
- Square format, 1:1.
- The three held plates and the three poster plates are the ONLY black rectangles in the
  picture, and every one of them is perfectly flat matte black.
- No words, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks or sponsor marks anywhere — not on the
  jackets, not on the kit, not in the gym, not on the plates.
- Clothing is mid-tone or light: nothing else in the frame may be as dark as the plates.
- Real hands: five separated fingers, natural grip, nothing deformed.
- Photorealistic, sharp, natural skin, believable available light.
